summary: Phone snatched from her hand in La Candelaria
story: On July 8 I was walking in La Candelaria in Bogota, checking a map on my phone, when a man ran past and took the phone out of my hand. I went to the police the same afternoon and their report is attached, along with the receipt for the phone, which I bought in March. I sent this in from my hostel in July but I am not sure it went through, so I am filing it again now that I am home.

documents.name: Police report
documents.content: Policia Nacional de Colombia, CAI La Candelaria, Bogota. Denuncia, July 8, 2026, 16:20. Reported by Isabel Moreno, United States citizen. At about 14:30 today on Carrera 2 a man on foot took a smartphone from the hand of the reporting person and ran toward Calle 12. Item: one smartphone, 256 GB, black. Report number BOG-2026-118734.

documents.name: Purchase receipt
documents.content: Queens Center Mobile, Elmhurst, March 21, 2026. Smartphone, 256 GB: $899.00. Card ending 7203, Isabel Moreno.
